name: ps2_pulse
title: PS2 liveness test
description: A screen that cycles colour once a second with a white square on it. Impossible to misread.
detail: Built after three hardware tests produced screens that could not be interpreted -- partly because one of them cleared to the same blue as uLaunchELF's own background. This has no textures, no pad and no state: the colour cycling proves the frame loop, and the white square proves filled rectangles.
